nodes.title: Living Adventure Companion
nodes.description: One contextual experience; this navigation tree is not itself a progression rule.

nodes.title: Mission Control
nodes.description: Multiple observed story choices and complete original Gold briefings.

nodes.title: Story choices
nodes.description: Show scenario-observed markers first; uncertain candidates separately; never sort as a forced numbered route.

nodes.title: Field Guide v1.1
nodes.description: Reconstruct selected original A-to-final mission dossier, Gold metrics and critical inline warnings. Never shrink into a mini-guide.

nodes.title: Free Roam Control
nodes.description: One featured PROJECT, one meaningful OUTING, optional DISCOVERY.

nodes.title: Projects
nodes.description: Long-term optional improvements with staged milestones; not progress trophies.

nodes.title: Outings
nodes.description: Short, meaningful adventures which are deferrable when Story pressure is real.

nodes.title: Discoveries
nodes.description: Player-observed opportunities, not pre-revealed spoilers or scripted pins.

nodes.title: Develop the Camp
nodes.description: A continuing optional project linked to four domain tracks: economy, facilities, Pearson, camp life.

nodes.title: Camp Economy
nodes.description: Contributions, debt returns and the Ledger; unlocking the Ledger does not purchase an upgrade.

summary_by_stage.unconfirmed: Inspect the donation box and available Strauss task; do not assume Ledger access.
summary_by_stage.unmet: The Ledger follows a qualifying debt return and deposit in the normal Story route.
summary_by_stage.eligible: Ledger prerequisites appear met; verify the actual interface.
summary_by_stage.observed: Ledger visible in the synthetic scenario; inspect choices, prices and funds separately.

nodes.title: Contributions and Debt Returns
nodes.description: The gang contribution box, individual donations and Strauss debt stages are distinct.

nodes.title: Camp Ledger
nodes.description: The camp-upgrade interface follows a qualifying deposited debt; it does not guarantee a purchase.

nodes.title: Facilities & Travel
nodes.description: Optional camp supplies, lodging benefits and a conditional fast-travel upgrade path.

summary_by_stage.unconfirmed: Camp upgrade options and purchases have not been inspected.
summary_by_stage.unmet: Lodging/fast travel purchases cannot be inferred from a Ledger alone.
summary_by_stage.eligible: Normal prerequisites for the lodging route are met; confirm actual upgrade menu.
summary_by_stage.observed: Lodging/fast travel state was explicitly supplied by the synthetic scenario.

nodes.title: Supplies & Provisions
nodes.description: Use observed camp stock, not invented permanent upgrade status.

nodes.title: Lodging & Fast Travel
nodes.description: Optional lodging-dependent convenience; menu price and payment not assumed.

nodes.title: Pearson Crafting
nodes.description: Tool purchase, satchel recipes and resource routing; preserve whole-carcass versus pelt distinctions.

summary_by_stage.unconfirmed: Learn Pearson's donation/crafting menus; tools or materials cannot be assumed.
summary_by_stage.unmet: Satchel crafting needs the separately purchased Leather Working Tools, plus recipe conditions.
summary_by_stage.eligible: The normal tool prerequisites are met but the purchase is not observed.
summary_by_stage.observed: Tools explicitly purchased in this synthetic scenario. Choose one exact satchel recipe; do not infer any satchel crafted.

nodes.title: Satchels
nodes.description: Per-item crafting requires its own unlock task and specified perfect materials.

nodes.title: Camp Decorations
nodes.description: Decoration recipes can have distinct material forms and eligibility; not all are tool-locked.

nodes.title: Camp Life & Requests
nodes.description: Chapter-sensitive camp conversations, invitations and item requests; an observed marker matters more than an encyclopedic schedule.

summary_by_stage.unconfirmed: Check actual camp people, invitations and item requests; none is presumed active.
summary_by_stage.observed: A chapter-sensitive companion activity is explicitly observed in the synthetic scenario; check its actual eligibility before proceeding.

nodes.title: Companion Activities
nodes.description: Only actually marked/observed qualifying outings receive a before-exit priority.

nodes.title: Item Requests
nodes.description: Character/time-dependent errands; do not invent a generated marker or item hand-in.

nodes.title: Horse Care
nodes.description: A skill-oriented project introduced through the normal Hosea story tutorial.

nodes.title: Horse Care Basics
nodes.description: Learn brushing, feeding and bonding; no owned horse or brush inferred.

summary_by_stage.unmet: Normal stable/brush introduction is not complete in this synthetic route.
summary_by_stage.eligible: General prerequisite appears met; verify tutorial and equipment.
summary_by_stage.observed: Horse-care system is explicitly observed in the fictional scenario.

nodes.title: Bonding & Travel
nodes.description: Practise bonding and horse safety alongside other outings.

nodes.title: Systems Atlas
nodes.description: Mechanics owned by S01–S30 Atlas families; no duplicate game mechanics stored in project cards.

nodes.title: Camp Systems
nodes.description: S08 provisions, S09 ledger, S10 Pearson, S11 camp life.

nodes.title: Horse Systems
nodes.description: S06 horse lifecycle, access, bonding and transport.

nodes.title: Hunting & Wildlife
nodes.description: S12 ordinary hunting, clean kills and transport.

nodes.title: Fishing
nodes.description: S14 fishing and later specialist requirements.
